label: Bible Study
prompt: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a _____ the foal of an ass.
verse: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion; shout, O daughter of Jerusalem: behold, thy King cometh unto thee: he is just, and having salvation; lowly, and riding upon an ass, and upon a colt the foal of an ass.
note: Fulfilled on Palm Sunday — Matthew and John both quote it as Jesus rides into Jerusalem.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Greet ye one another with a _____ of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
verse: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus. Amen.
note: Peter signs off warmly — a kiss of charity all round, and peace to everyone in Christ.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Ye see how _____ a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
verse: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
note: Near the end of Galatians, Paul takes up the pen himself — 'how large a letter I have written... with mine own hand.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a _____, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
verse: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
note: The nations are like a drop from a bucket and dust on the scales — not even worth weighing.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited _____, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.
verse: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness.
note: 'Whited sepulchres' — tombs painted bright white: gleaming outside, dead men's bones within. Jesus' sharpest woe.
